summary: NetClass Technology Inc filed a Form 6-K disclosing two service agreements for technical development services. On May 6, 2026, the company entered into a Technical Development Service Agreement with Bangyuan Liu and an AI-Based Technology R&D Services Agreement with Akaewood Investment Holding Co., Ltd. As consideration, the company issued 2,800,000 and 3,200,000 Class A ordinary shares, respectively, on June 15, 2026. The shares were issued as restricted securities under Regulation S. This is an ordinary course operational contract, not a special situation event.
